query: What empirically justified ΔE00 tolerance ranges should be used for displays, projectors, and print when reproducing pastel targets?

response.query: What empirically justified ΔE00 tolerance ranges should be used for displays, projectors, and print when reproducing pastel targets?
response.answer: For pastel targets, use ΔE00 tolerance ranges of 3-5 for displays, 5-7 for projectors, and 7-10 for print. These values ensure accurate color reproduction.

results.title: AIC 2010, Color and Food - From the Farm to the Table
results.content: Address: Takao Sato, Department of Psychology, Graduate School in Humanities and Sociology, University of Tokyo, 7-3-1 Hongo, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo, 113-0033, Japan E-mail: lsato@mail.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp AIC 2010 Color and Food, Interim Meeting of the International Color Association – Proceedings 616 Colour opponency in chromatic after-effects Hitomi SHIMAKURA,1 Katsuaki SAKATA2 1 Postdoctoral Fellows, National Institute of Advanced Industrial Science and Technology 2 Faculty of Arts, Joshibi University of Art and Design, Japan ABSTRACT We measured the aftereffects of chromatic adaptation following the stimulation of L and M cones with different colors and the same color to validate the hypothesis that chromatic adaptation is achieved by not only photoreceptors but also a binocular integrated process occurring at the cerebral cortex.
